editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when the meanest person you know finally kicks the bucket? You get Coleman F. Sweeney, a guy who basically treats life like one big prank at everyone else's expense. He is selfish, rude, and honestly kind of a nightmare to be around. The whole vibe of the movie is a wild ride that explores how people react when a total jerk suddenly disappears from the world. It starts off as a dark comedy that makes you laugh at how bad he is, but it quickly turns into something more surprising as his hidden side comes to light.

The acting is spot on, and the pacing keeps you moving without feeling bored. You will love how the movie flips the script on you, though some of the slower moments in the middle might feel a bit long. If you enjoy dark humor and weird character studies, you should definitely give this a go. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that Coleman was not just a monster for no reason. The twist reveals that his mean behavior was actually a shield to protect others from his own internal pain. As the story wraps up, the people he pushed away finally see the small, kind things he did in secret. He finds peace and redemption, showing that even the worst person can have a heart of gold beneath the surface.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and stories about redemption.
